opportunities.title: Cara's Fellowship Programme
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to direct applications from individual academics at risk in their home country or who have been recently displaced, regardless of nationality, who are being forced to flee by the risk of imminent imprisonment, injury or death. Some need PhD/postgraduate qualifications; others already hold doctorates seeking postdoctoral placements.
opportunities.summary: Rescue mission to help academics at risk find temporary refuge in universities and research institutions (mostly in the UK) where they can continue their work. Cara checks applicants' backgrounds, helps negotiate placements, allocates additional funding, and assists with visas and practical arrangements. Provides 2- or 3-year awards as standard. Applications considered on a rolling basis.
